units.source_text: 我带着一种感动的心情眺望着地上的物象如此敏感地映照天上的色彩。

en.t: With a feeling of deep emotion, I gazed at how sensitively the things on earth reflected the colors of the heavens.

units.source_text: 有了笼罩庙内的绿的雨员的滋润，所有这一切都接受了天上的赐福。

en.t: Moistened by the green rain that enveloped the temple grounds, all of this had received the blessing of the heavens.

units.source_text: 这一切恰似接受恩宠似的湿润了，散发出一种腐败和新鲜混杂的气味，因为它们不知道如何拒绝接受这种赐福。

en.t: Everything had grown moist as if touched by grace, giving off an odor in which decay and freshness were mingled, because these things did not know how to refuse such a blessing.
